title: Harden K2 shortcut tests: Cmd+Shift+S save-not-fired, Esc cancels recording
description: From the T148 review: (1) the Cmd+Shift+S test only checks the snapshot dialog opens, so it passes even if save also fires again -- add a non-vacuous assertion (e.g. make the project dirty, press Cmd+Shift+S, assert the save status does not flip to Saved / no save call) and show it failing on a doctored copy where save also fires; (2) add a test that Escape cancels recording a new chord in Settings > Shortcuts and leaves the old chord; (3) add a resolveChord unit case mapping Cmd+Shift+S to snapshot (not save) in src/shortcuts/shortcuts.test.ts. Test-only unless a real bug appears. Logs under the task cache folder.

review.note: Reviewed test-only change: read the two new Playwright tests and unit cases; reran vitest src/shortcuts 11/11 pass; pw.log 4/4 and fail-first logs (pw-failfirst 2 failed on doctored copies, vitest-failfirst 3 failed) present in ui3-k2-tests. Cmd+Shift+S test asserts Unsaved edits persists (non-vacuous). Did not rerun Playwright.
